settings.title: Public page
settings.description: Theme, languages, online durations, conditions and the code to embed the widget in your website.

booking.title: Online bookings
booking.description: Turn on the public page and choose the websites that may embed it.
booking.enabledHint: Off: the page stays visible with the contacts but nobody can book.
booking.origins: Websites allowed to embed the page
booking.originsHint: One origin per line, for example https://www.examplebeach.com. Empty: direct link only.

flow.title: Booking flow
flow.description: What customers can choose on the public page.
flow.formulasHint: None selected: all those allowed by the packages sold online.
flow.maxDaysAheadHint: Maximum days in advance, on top of the online policy limits. Empty: no extra limit.
flow.showRatePeriods: Highlight rate periods in the calendar

offer.title: Areas and packages sold online
offer.description: Online visibility is set on each area (seat, area or quantity mode) and on the packages and extras with the online channel; lead time, deposit and cancellation rules are in the online policy.

settings.themeDescription: Colours, font and texts of the page: the preview on the right is the real page in test mode and updates while you edit, before saving.
settings.previewOpen: Open the preview in a new tab
settings.previewHint: You can try every step in the preview: no booking is created.

embed.title: Embed code
embed.description: Direct link and code to paste into the beach club's website.
embed.script: Recommended code (script: handles height, language and dates)
embed.originsList: Allowed websites: {{origins}}. On other websites the browser blocks the embedding.
embed.originsNone: No website allowed: the page only works as a direct link. Add your website under “Online bookings”.
embed.events: The script re-dispatches the arenile:booked (booking code only), arenile:resize and arenile:navigate events on the host page, useful to track conversions. Optional parameters: data-lang, data-from, data-to, data-pack.

terms.title: Conditions and privacy notice
terms.description: Immutable versions: checkout asks to accept the current version and every booking records the one accepted.
terms.emptyHint: Publish the booking conditions before opening online bookings.
terms.publishDescription: Published versions cannot be changed. The text in the default language is required.
terms.versionHint: Readable identifier, for example the publication date.
terms.marketingHint: Optional, shown next to the separate consent checkbox.
terms.makeCurrentHint: From the next checkout customers accept this version.

payments.title: Online payments
payments.description: Connect Stripe to take payments online: keys are encrypted and never shown again.

status.title: Status
status.description: Active provider and check of the saved credentials.

payments.manualHint: Online bookings are paid at the beach club or confirmed according to the online policy.
payments.incomplete: To take payments online you need the secret key and the webhook secret.

provider.title: Provider and keys
provider.description: Keys are in the Stripe dashboard under Developers → API keys.
provider.label: Provider

payments.liveWarning: Live mode: customers will be charged. Try a payment in test mode first.
payments.secretKeyHint: Starts with sk_{{mode}}_ (or rk_{{mode}}_ for a restricted key). Leave empty to keep it.
payments.webhookSecretHint: Starts with whsec_: you find it in the webhook created in Stripe. Leave empty to keep it.
payments.embeddedHint: Available in a future version: today payment opens on the secure Stripe Checkout page.

webhook.title: Stripe webhook
webhook.description: A booking is confirmed only when Stripe notifies the payment to this address.
webhook.url: Endpoint URL to paste in Stripe
webhook.step1: In Stripe open Developers → Webhooks and add an endpoint with this URL.
webhook.step2: Select the events listed above and save.
webhook.step3: Copy the signing secret (whsec_…) into the field above and press “Check credentials”.

local.title: Stripe cannot reach this address
local.description: The address is local (this computer or the establishment's network): Stripe sends webhooks only to public HTTPS addresses. To try payments from here, forward the events with the Stripe CLI and use the webhook secret it prints (whsec_…). In production, publish Arenile on a domain reachable from the internet.
local.command: Command to run on this computer

validation.publishable: The publishable key starts with pk_test_ or pk_live_
validation.secret: The secret key starts with sk_test_, sk_live_, rk_test_ or rk_live_
validation.webhook: The webhook secret starts with whsec_
validation.mode: The key does not match the chosen mode

blocked.title: Online payments blocked for real customers
blocked.description: The payment provider is set up with test keys while Arenile's Test mode is off: customers cannot pay online, so nobody gets a confirmed booking with a fake card. Enter the live keys to take real payments, or turn on Test mode to try the flow.

email.title: Email and notifications
email.description: Sender, customer and manager notifications, test email and delivery log.

transport.title: Email delivery
transport.description: The mail server is configured when Arenile starts and is read-only here.
transport.log: No SMTP: emails in the log
transport.file: No SMTP: emails saved to files
transport.logHint: Without ARENILE_SMTP_URL emails are only recorded in the log (masked recipient). Set ARENILE_SMTP_URL and ARENILE_MAIL_FROM to really send them.
transport.fileHint: Emails are saved as .eml files in the ARENILE_MAIL_DIR folder (development and tests). Set ARENILE_SMTP_URL to really send them.

settings.title: Sender and notifications
settings.description: Name shown to customers, reply address and active notifications.
settings.managerEmailHint: Receives the notifications for the establishment.

customer.confirmation: Confirmation with manage link, QR and calendar
customer.remindersMoved: Balance and day-before reminders are set in "Customer emails".

test.title: Test email
test.description: Check that emails go out and do not end up in spam.
test.queued: Test email queued: check the log below.
test.failed: Could not queue the test email.

log.title: Delivery log
log.description: Latest emails sent or queued; recipients are masked and the content is not kept.
log.emptyHint: Emails go out when online bookings are confirmed and from desk actions.

customerEmails.title: Customer emails
customerEmails.description: Automatic reminders and the texts of the emails your customers receive, in every language.

reminders.title: Automatic reminders
reminders.description: Arenile sends them on its own, once per booking, in the establishment timezone.
reminders.dayBeforeHint: The day before arrival at {{time}}, with QR and summary.
reminders.dayBeforeTime: Send time of the day-before reminder
reminders.balanceHint: At {{time}}, before the balance due date set by the policy.
reminders.balanceTime: Send time of the balance reminder
reminders.leadDays: When, compared to the balance due date
reminders.rules: Not sent for test, cancelled or expired bookings, customers without email and, for the balance, when nothing is left to pay. The balance due date comes from the booking policy ("N days before" or on arrival).

editor.title: Email texts
editor.description: Subject, opening text, closing text and signature of every email. QR, summary, amounts, manage link and footer stay fixed; logo and colours come from the theme.
editor.subject: Subject
editor.counter: {{count}} of {{max}} characters. Plain text: an empty line separates paragraphs.
editor.fixed: Fixed blocks between opening and closing text: {{blocks}}.
editor.restoreDescription: The customised texts of this email and language will be deleted.

preview.title: Preview
preview.subject: Subject
preview.sample: With a sample booking: no real customer data.
preview.invalid: Fix the texts to update the preview.

validation.placeholder: Unknown placeholder: use only those in the list.
validation.oneLine: The subject must fit on one line.
